WITH event_group AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event, e.status,
         AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS group_avg
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN event AS e ON CAST(b.link_to_event AS BLOB) = CAST(e.event_id AS BLOB)
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT status, AVG(group_avg) AS status_avg
  FROM event_group
  GROUP BY status
),
joined AS (
  SELECT eg.group_avg, sa.status_avg,
         eg.group_avg / sa.status_avg AS ratio
  FROM event_group AS eg
  JOIN status_avg AS sa ON CAST(eg.status AS BLOB) = CAST(sa.status AS BLOB)
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg FROM joined
),
kept AS (
  SELECT j.group_avg, j.ratio, j.group_avg - oa.overall_avg AS difference
  FROM joined AS j
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa
  WHERE j.group_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(group_avg), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference) FROM kept
